text:
maria: Heads-up — we flipped the hybrid KV prefix cache (v3) to canary on prod-c and immediate perf numbers look promising.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-10T14:45Z -> prod-c succeeded :white_check_mark:

maria: Quick summary from initial 10% traffic: p50 generation latency down ~9%, p95 down ~15%, p99 down ~20%. Cost per token estimated -11% using the same batch sizes.

ajay: Do you have the raw numbers? Can we see the request distribution and sequences used?

maria: pasted below from the dashboard snapshot:
```
baseline p50 120ms -> 109ms
baseline p95 520ms -> 440ms
baseline p99 1120ms -> 900ms
token cost $0.0064 -> $0.0057 per 1k
```

sophie: Amazing. Any changes needed in client side? Are cache-miss penalties visible for long-tail sequences?

maria: No client changes. Miss penalty is slightly higher but overall wins — miss rate dropped from 28% -> 12% due to prefix merging heuristics.

dbenson: Monitoring look OK? Any alerts firing?

monitor-bot: KVCacheMissRate on prod-c dropped: 28% -> 12%. No new error spikes. trace-sampler flagged 3 anomalous timeouts during rollout window.

ajay: Let's extend canary to 30% for 4 hours, then schedule full rollout tomorrow if stable. Also add a regression eval run against the llm-quality-suite.

maria: Agree. I'll schedule ramp and the eval. Thanks everyone — nice win :tada:

sophie: :champagne:
